description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-25. -->
## YouTube

- **Home filters:** The existing Shorts and community post filters now also cover standalone full-width Shorts and multi-image post cards. Regular videos and unrelated carousels are not filtered by these rules. (#95)
- **Home channel names:** With **Show channel names on Home** on, channel names stay visible in Classic and Default after searching, returning to Home, and refreshing. Cards that supply only a handle keep it; search results are unchanged. (#83)
- **Player labels:** Restoring the old YouTube settings screen no longer removes the timestamp or appended video quality when **Hide Fullscreen button** is on. **Hide timestamp** still works. (#93)
- **Seekbar:** The custom gradient keeps a clean accent-colored end in Dark portrait playback after the controls fade. On YouTube 20.05.46, the Minimal and Tablet miniplayers show the buffered portion again. (#71)
- **RVX Downloads:** Pause and resume from the Downloads screen or its notification. An interrupted transfer keeps the bytes it already wrote and continues automatically when the connection returns. A manually paused download stays paused; resuming does not survive a force-stop. Long seeks in saved files larger than 2 GiB work in YouTube's watch player, both players support custom speeds such as `0.05×` and `2.75×` without changing pitch, and the built-in player supports swiping up or down to enter or exit fullscreen. YouTube Premium downloads are unchanged. (#84)

## YouTube and YouTube Music

- **Glass menus:** Prepare the translucent panel before its first draw where supported, avoid the dim flash on opening the player gear menu, and refresh the blur after returning from Recents. Surfaces without blur support keep their stock style. (#89)
- **RVX settings:** Aligned 11 misaligned summaries across both apps without shifting icons or changing the layout of other settings. (#94)

Add or refresh `https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches` as a remote patch source in Morphe Manager or UP Manager, then repatch and install your app with **v1.52.0**. Existing stable and dev JSON source URLs still work and update automatically from published releases.
